title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle Inc. Announce Recall of Mongoose 20-Inch Mountain Bicycles
summary: The rear shock absorber allows the aluminum dual-suspension frame to flex severely, causing the frame to become unstable and break, posing the risk of injury to riders. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, Valley Dynamo Announce Recall of Air Hockey Tables
summary: The blower motor, located under the table, has an opening large enough for a child's finger, posing a laceration hazard. Units: Approximately 15,000.

title: CPSC, Shindaiwa Inc. Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers
summary: The muffler's retaining bolts can allow the muffler to come loose from the engine while the hedge trimmer is in operation. A loose muffler can contact and damage the fuel tank, creating a fire hazard. Units: 15,000.

title: CPSC, Mattel, Inc. Announce Recall of BATMAN™ BATMOBILE™ Toy Vehicle
summary: The rear tail wings of the Batmobile are made of rigid plastic and come to a point, which poses a potential puncture or laceration hazard to young children. Units: 314,000.

title: CPSC, Tek Nek Toys Announce Recall of Ride-On Toys
summary: The screw and nut assembly, attaching the steering wheel, can come loose, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 70,000.

title: CPSC, Ethan Allen Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
summary: A metal "j" hook on the guardrails can become dislodged, allowing the guardrail to slide or move out of position. This can allow the guardrail to detach from the bunk bed or allow the occupant to roll off the top bunk. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, Nikko America Announce Recall of Radio-Control Toy Trucks
summary: A problem with the circuit board causes the toy truck to overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 287,000.

title: CPSC, Deere & Company Announce Recall of Compact Utility Tractors
summary: Some of the steel bolts used to secure Roll-Over Protective Structure (ROPS) to the tractor's real axle can shear off, decreasing the strength of the ROPS and its ability to protect the operator, in the event of a roll-over incident. Units: 300.

title: CPSC, H&M Announce Recall of Promotional Water Bottles
summary: The pull-up black plastic drinking spout can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 6,300.

title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of TV/VCR Carts that Can Tip Over Easily, after Baby's Death
summary: The carts can tip over and injure or kill children and adults when the cart and the television fall. Units: About 592,000.

title: CPSC, L&N Sales and Marketing Announce Recall of Cordless Sweepers Sold on QVC
summary: The sweeper can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: 59,400.

title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Fireplace Remote Receivers
summary: The circuit board can overheat and catch fire, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: 4,360.

title: CPSC, Trojan Technologies Announce Recall of Residential Water Disinfection Systems
summary: Some of the lamp pins used in these disinfection systems are improperly soldered, and can cause the units to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,900 sold in the U.S. (About 12,500 sold worldwide).

title: CPSC, White-Rodgers Announce Recall of LP and Convertible Gas Water Heater Temperature Controls
summary: The gas water heater controls can gradually open instead of snapping open to full flow, which can cause soot to build up on the water heater burner, presenting a fire hazard. Units: 88,000.

title: CPSC, Ashley Furniture Industries Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds
summary: There are gaps between parts of the bunk bed that violate federal safety standards and can be entrapment or strangulation hazards to children. title: CPSC, Hamilton Beach Announce Recall of Espresso/Cappuccino Makers
summary: The steam tube inside the espresso/cappuccino maker can burst under pressure, presenting a risk of injury to consumers. This can occur if the frothing nozzle becomes clogged and the espresso button is pushed while attempting to froth milk. Units: 20,160.

title: CPSC, Virgo Enterprises Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
summary: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water. title: CPSC, American Standard Companies Announce Recall of Trane and American Standard Accessory Electric Heaters
summary: Overheating of the wiring in the accessory heater can lead to wall thermostat fires. Units: About 37,000.

title: CPSC, Kids II Announce Recall of Children's Mirror Books
summary: The mirror in the books can crack or break, posing a laceration hazard to young children. Units: 225,000.
